limitations: CLI token fields are copied from each agent.jsonl turn.completed usage object. They are aggregate counters; reasoning output is reported as its own field and is not added again to output tokens.

Tool-failure counts cover command_execution items whose recorded status is failed. They do not treat failed test assertions, intentional server shutdowns, and infrastructure setup errors as equivalent, so the breakdown preserves those categories.
A repair round is stated as explicit only when the agent gave a count. For PlayCanvas, the five count is an observable failed-proof/edit/retry count rather than an agent-claimed total.

Screenshot capture accounting covers agent-invoked proof scripts, not the independent evaluator's own screenshots. Actual visual inspection remains unknown unless an image-view action or explicit inspection statement was recorded.

Source-file lists come from changes.diff plus the agent's final inventory and omit copied BRIEF.md, regenerated dist files, and generated evidence artifacts. They describe paths changed, not semantic change size.
Evaluator v2 is used for readiness-sensitive scoring. Later v3 reruns also exist and strengthen the batch-versus-single-tick case, but they are outside this requested v2 normalization.
